description: Four independent unsigned 8-bit saturating adders. Lane k reads a[8k+:8] and b[8k+:8]. result[8k+:8]=min(a_k+b_k,255). aux[3:0]=lanes that saturated. fault=any lane saturated. No lane ever wraps.
hardware_advantage: A scalar core needs one saturating-add instruction per pixel; this retires 4 pixels every enabled cycle at II=1 and the overflow path is not a branch.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
qualification: engineering candidate; not certified production or side-channel protection
